text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well, well, well… You know what this means, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! But I haven't even said what your punishment is yet!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, it's nothing too difficult… Though, it will take some elbow grease.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll be working right alongside you too. Come on, time to make good friends with the brooms and mops in Ritto Dorm!
